title: Liquor excise returns
description: A liquor retailer's excise return figures from its own stock: per store and period, the volume and the volume of pure alcohol per duty class, kept as filed. A duty class (PP EXR Duty Class) holds its name and the authority's code; three fields on Item give an item's duty class, its millilitres per stock unit and its strength (alcohol by volume). A return (PP EXR Return) for one company, one store (a warehouse), a period and a unit (Litres or US gallons) has a Desk button while it is a draft: Work out the return (Stock User, Stock Manager) has the service read, from the store's stock ledger, each item's balance at the end of the day before From and at the end of To, and the period's movements, and write twelve lines per duty class: opening stock, received from suppliers, transferred in, returned by customers, other in, sold, transferred out, returned to suppliers, written off, other out, the count difference and closing stock, each in units, volume and pure alcohol. A return's company, store, period and unit are set once, so its lines are always of that period. The workflow's File step (Stock Manager only) moves a draft to Filed, and Drop (Stock User) puts aside a draft not wanted; a save rule keeps a filed or dropped return's figures as they were (it installs switched off: switch it on); the filing date and reference stay for the manager to fill. The Excise return worksheet prints the lines under the retailer's letter head. The install makes the role and the app's own user; the retailer gives the role Read on Stock Ledger Entry, Stock Entry and Item, and leaves the feed off. No customer, price or money leaves the site: the service reads stock quantities, entries' purposes and items. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

fields.label: Duty class
fields.description: As your excise authority names it: Spirits, Wine, Beer, Ready to drink, or a strength band.

fields.label: Authority's code
fields.description: The code or line your return form gives this class, if it has one. It prints beside the class.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Such as which products belong here, or the rule that sets the band.

fields.label: Movement
fields.options:
Opening stock
Received from suppliers
Transferred in
Returned by customers
Other in
Sold
Transferred out
Returned to suppliers
Written off
Other out
Count difference
Closing stock

fields.label: Pure alcohol
fields.description: The volume times each item's strength, in the return's unit.

fields.label: Store
fields.description: The store's warehouse. One return a store: its stock ledger is read, nothing else.

fields.label: To
fields.description: Inclusive. Work the return out once every till of the store has synced and its last day is closed. The store, the period and the unit are set once: for another period, make a new return.

fields.label: Filed on
fields.description: The day you filed it with the authority. The manager fills it once the return is filed.

fields.label: Filing reference
fields.description: The authority's receipt or reference number.

custom_fields.label: Duty class
custom_fields.description: For an excise return: the duty class this product is returned under. Leave empty for anything not excisable.

custom_fields.label: Millilitres per stock unit
custom_fields.description: The volume of one stock unit: 750 for a 750 ml bottle, 9000 for a case of twelve kept in cases.

custom_fields.label: Alcohol by volume
custom_fields.description: The strength printed on the label, such as 40 for a spirit at 40%.

save_rules.rule_name: PP EXR return locked once filed
save_rules.message: This return is filed or dropped: its store, period and figures stay as they were. Make a new return for a correction.
